newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Colruyt jumps seven pct in Brussels.
newsitem.headline: Colruyt jumps seven pct in Brussels.

text.p: Belgian retailer Colruyt surged seven percent on Thursday on a combination of rumours it might sell its Dolmen Computer unit, the fact it had been lagging the market in recent months, analysts' recommendations and reports it had been included in a European investment fund.
At 1157 GMT, Colruyt was up 6.2 percent at 15,950 francs after it earlier set a new record high of 16,100.

"It's up because of Dolmen," one dealer said. "Analysts are very positive about Colruyt," another said. They said it was one of the last of leading shares not to have used up its upward potential but would run out of steam at these levels.
Dealers also said that players were once again focusing on Colruyt in the run-up to its 1996/1997 full-year results which will be published on June 26.
